descriptions.description: Chlorophytum laxum (Bichetii grass, Siam lily, false lily turf, wheat plant) is a flowering plant species in the genus Chlorophytum, widespread through tropical Africa, Asia, and Australia.

Synonyms Anthericum bichetii Anthericum parviflorum Chlorophytum abyssinicum Chlorophytum acaule Chlorophytum bichetii Chlorophytum debile Chlorophytum falcatum Chlorophytum javanicum Chlorophytum laxiflorum Chlorophytum laxum f. javanicum Chlorophytum parviflorum Chlorophytum xerotinum Nolina javanica Phalangium laxum Phalangium parviflorum
